children: Hypercall is scheduled to open its first SLP market-making vault and covered call vaults by November 8, 2026. The SLP vault accepts USDC deposits to fund an options market-making book. The covered call vaults hold stocks and sell call options each week.
The vaults are the first live part of the SYN-linked exchange. The initial vaults start small, and their link to the token at launch is indirect.

title: Synapse: Hypercall opens its first options vaults - By 08 Nov 2026
